record.issue_text: packages/core/EventManager.ts:380 — destinations without a credentialId call `createEvent(c, event)` with no externalId, so the persisted BookingReference gets `externalCalendarId: undefined` and later updates/deletes can no longer target the right calendar

adjudication.rationale: In `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`, when iterating `event.destinationCalendar`, the `else` branch for destinations without `credentialId` does `createEvent(c, event)` (no `externalId` argument) even though the loop still has access to `destination.externalId`. `CalendarManager.createEvent` now returns `{ externalId }` from its optional argument (it does not derive it from `calEvent.destinationCalendar`), and later `EventManager` persists `externalCalendarId: isCalendarType ? result.externalId : undefined`. Therefore these created calendar references will have `externalCalendarId` as `undefined`, which (as shown elsewhere in the diff) is relied upon for later `updateEvent`/`deleteEvent` targeting via `reference.externalCalendarId`.
